TC-02/S06.title: Imperfect photos still give a usable result (dev)
TC-02/S06.detail: Dev (<dev address>, build 25acd727), dataset lane pl-tc02 (QA_TARGET=dev scripts/datasets/run.sh pl-tc02 under runs/.dev.lock, Quinn's saved session, 2026-10-17 01:01–01:04 JST), real vision model. Raw scanCensusSheet rows read from the page's own socket (ActionResponse of the scan request), diagnostics:list for model and timing. Photos from cases/fixtures/devprep-photo10/media (truth from render-media LAYOUTS). census-hosp-rotated and census-nh-rotated were read: both returned [] ('No patients found…' / 'No residents found…'), gemini-3.6-flash ok, 2945 / 7958 ms. After two empty reads the case stopped (brief 4: no retry loop); not read: census-hosp/nh-clean, -smudge, -cutoff, -handwritten (8 photos), so the Q3 9/10 threshold could not be counted. Judged per read: the diagnostics row names Gemini Flash with durationMs and providerMs (2/2). Known B01.
